methods.notes: Exact-prefix evidence from the advertisement and LOYPRO app's scan list. Do not add 0xFFF0 here: doing so would reactivate every unrelated FFF0-based spec as a candidate. Advertising is intermittent, so rediscover freshly and do not persist a stale address.

identification.notes: LOYPRO 2.1.04 explicitly accepts this prefix in its scan filter. LOY PLAY 1.7.15 and LOY SPACE 1.2.19 accept only YS/TL, so do not conflate the three app families. The digits after LOY have no proven model or resolution meaning.

device.name: LOY / LOYPRO Helmet LED Display
device.notes:
Confirmed LOY/LOYPRO helmet display using the AA55 binary-TLV family. The observed physical unit is a helmet-worn motorcycle display. Its exact hardware/reseller model is unknown; the device-information model field is literally `server`, and the advertised digits have no proven model or resolution meaning. The 48x16 geometry comes from the live panel TLV, not those digits.
FFF0 is retained in `services` for post-connect use, never as an identification signal: unrelated LED panels, thermometers, battery monitors, OBD adapters and treadmills all advertise it. AUTOBABA is a protocol relative but expects YS/TL, so it must not be selected for this LOY-named helmet. The older Shining Display helmet platform uses FA02 and is a different protocol.
This unit reports `car_linkage` and `brake`. That proves a firmware capability, not the event source: an integrated accelerometer, wireless accessory, wired vehicle input or another mechanism remain possible. Do not infer wiring or motion-triggered animations from those tokens alone.

openness.notes: The LOYPRO app (com.yskj.loypro) explicitly accepts advertised names beginning LOY, unlike the LOY PLAY and LOY SPACE app versions that accept only YS and TL. That prefix, not the widely shared 0xFFF0 service, is the scan-time discriminator for this candidate.

pairing.notes: The confirmed query session used no pairing. The wider codec has an optional password capability, but no configured password was observed. If enabled, use the owner's normal app flow rather than guessing or bypassing it.

credentials.notes: No account, Wi-Fi credential or pairing secret is established. The device reports pwd support, but whether a password is configured is unknown; use the owner's normal flow if one is enabled.

factory_reset.effect: No reset is established. Do not use a display-format or delete-all command as a pairing or identification probe.

methods.description: Match the LOY prefix, enumerate services and characteristics, subscribe to FFF1, then issue the source-derived AA55 information query on FFF2 with response=False. The observed unit completed this flow and returned a checksum-valid response.
methods.name: LOYPRO information query and identification

steps.action: Scan for a fresh LOY-prefixed advertisement and connect without persisting a stale address.
Enumerate GATT and confirm FFF2 is write-without-response and FFF1 is notify.
Subscribe to FFF1 and request device/panel information using protocol_details.read_only_identification.
steps.expect: A checksum-valid AA55 reply identifying firmware, capabilities and little-endian width/height; stop if the dialect differs.

setup.notes: No account or provisioning is required for the confirmed BLE display path. The information query and notification subscription were run successfully without pairing. Start read-only: enumerate GATT, subscribe to FFF1 and use the information query after selecting this LOYPRO candidate. Do not send another protocol's initialization.

rejoin.notes: Rediscover by the exact advertised name and confirmed characteristic layout. A previous address may be stale, and advertising may pause after disconnect or with power state.

testing.notes: On 2026-11-08 this project used the documented 20-byte dev_info_all query on a helmet-worn unit. The checksum-valid 159-byte reply confirmed FFF2 write-without-response and FFF1 notify, little-endian 48x16 panel geometry, fixed brightness 15, power type 1, and remote/car_linkage/ brake/HS:2/MTU:512/power capabilities. Only an information query and notification subscription were used; no display, configuration, pairing, reset or firmware write was performed.

artifacts.description: Name and advertised 0xFFF0, RSSI -59 dBm; no manufacturer or service-data record retained. Address and raw payloads deliberately omitted. Advertising was intermittent in later scans.

Confirmed one FFF0 service containing FFF2 and FFF1 and successful FFF1 notification enabling. The log omitted characteristic properties and contained no display-command write or reply. The secondary 5833ff service was absent only in that session, not proven absent from the device or other firmware states.

Fresh name-based discovery, complete GATT enumeration and one source-derived information query. Confirmed write-without-response and notify properties, a checksum-valid 159-byte reply, little-endian 48x16 geometry, brightness 15 and the capability tokens listed in this spec. No display, configuration, pairing, reset or firmware write was performed.

artifacts.description: Established that LOYPRO accepts LOY while the other app version accepts only YS/TL, and corroborated the FFF0/FFF2/FFF1 map, AA55 family and vehicle-linkage program paths. No vendor classes, methods, source paths or UI text are reproduced.
Independent LOY PLAY / YSKJ client with the same service map and AA55 framing. Tested another named device, not the observed LOY unit.

features.notes: Read little-endian panel TLV 0x1b before rendering; the observed unit is 48x16. Raw-GIF support on related YS-family backpacks is not proof of compatibility with this LOYPRO helmet. No display-content write was attempted on this unit.

initialization.notes: Open display replies before the information query or any display command.

covers: FFF2 information query with sequence-matched, checksum-valid FFF1 reply
Little-endian panel geometry, power and fixed-brightness reads
Firmware capability discovery for remote, car_linkage, brake and power
not_covered: Display content writes, raw-GIF upload, settings, binding, reset and OTA
Accelerometer or motion-trigger evidence, live brake events and vehicle-linkage mappings
local_access.summary: The documented dev_info_all query works locally over BLE. Other commands and uploads remain unverified on this unit.

family_evidence.not_evidence_for: Exact retail model, raw-GIF compatibility, optional maintenance services in other firmware states, or a particular vehicle-trigger mechanism.
family_evidence.transport_shape: AA55 framing, sequence, flags/mode, TLV payloads and little-endian additive checksum

read_only_identification.notes: Twenty-byte AA55 dev_info_all query with example sequence 1, now confirmed on the helmet. Subscribe to FFF1 first and use FFF2 without response. A real client increments its sequence counter. Device- information TLV 0x0a carries identity/model/version/capabilities; panel TLV 0x1b carries a leading panel-data-type byte followed by little-endian width and height. Power TLV 0x04 reports type 1 and brightness TLV 0x06 reports fixed value 15. Stop if no valid AA55 reply arrives; do not try another protocol's initialization as a fallback.

observed_reply.note: The MTU string is a firmware capability, not a negotiated-MTU measurement. Unit-specific identity and CID values are deliberately omitted.

tlv_length_encoding.extended_16: 82 LL LH: little-endian u16 length (256 and above)

next_read_only_queries.note: Use only after a fresh connection and only after the information response has confirmed the family. Stop if the first reply is invalid. No binding, mapping or display writes.

vehicle_linkage.notes: These are app-assignable display program IDs, not demonstrated motion gestures. The app offers a separate type-2 binding operation, which was not attempted and must not be sent during read-only confirmation. Generic vehicle-accessory instructions do not establish that this helmet requires wiring or contains an accelerometer.

remaining_unknowns: Exact hardware/reseller model and whether the advertised digits have serial/model semantics. Firmware V2.9.1#V18 and 48x16 geometry are confirmed.
Vehicle-linkage mappings, sensor type/value, actual brake event source, and whether any accelerometer or motion-triggered animation path exists.
Whether 5833ff, Nordic DFU or other maintenance services exist in other firmware states. The completed live discovery showed only FFF0.
Raw-GIF compatibility, display writes, settings, password configuration, reset and OTA.
Whether intermittent advertising is firmware policy, power-state behavior or another central holding the connection.

services.notes: Complete live discovery on 2026-11-08 confirmed this service and its FFF2/FFF1 children. Only FFF0 appeared in that session; this does not exclude other services in other firmware states. FFF0 is shared by many unrelated protocols and must not identify the device by itself.
